```plato
//==
// # Matrix interface
//
// The interface shared by every dense numeric matrix: element access by zero-based
// row and column, over the IAdditive and IScalable surface every matrix supports.
// The implementing types are declared in `matrices.types.plato`; the interface-generic
// helpers derived from this interface (Trace, FrobeniusNorm, IsSquare, ...) live in
// `numeric-structures.library.plato`.

// The family of matrix types: element access by zero-based row and column.
interface IMatrix
    inherits IValue, IAdditive, IScalable
{
    RowCount(x: Self): Integer;
    ColumnCount(x: Self): Integer;
    ElementAt(x: Self, row: Integer, column: Integer): Number;
}
```
